name: FSUE NAMI (Central Scientific Research Automobile and Automotive Engines Institute)
note: Russian federal state unitary enterprise (ФГУП «НАМИ») subordinate to the Ministry of Industry and Trade of the Russian Federation. Sole owner of AvtoVAZ since May 2023, when Rostec transferred its 32.3% share in the controlling holding company Lada Auto Holding to NAMI (NAPI, 17.05.2023; AUTOSTAT, 12.05.2023).
